title: Replay budget inequality
statement: For natural numbers $n,k,l,W,T,R,a$, suppose $a\le 2n+4+k(3W+7)+(4l+7)(T+1)^2$ and $R\le 2l(T+1)^2$. Then $a+2R+4\le 2n+8+k(3W+7)+(8l+7)(T+1)^2$.
replaced: For all naturals, if a recording time is at most $2n + 4 + k(3W+7) + (4l+7)(T+1)^2$ and a replayed length is at most $2l(T+1)^2$, then the recording time plus twice the replayed length plus four is at most $2n + 8 + k(3W+7) + (8l+7)(T+1)^2$.
